acceptanceCriteria: an oversized guard span is refused or skipped at emission with a test, using one shared bound
body: Residual from the V1-1266 lane (PR #944, head 5f98009ae, TCQ-V0-062 corvint cem verify --guarding-tests). Codex finding 5 (P2), recorded as a limit: the test-claim plan row is not checked against the cem cite 1 MiB span bound, which lives in internal/cem/workflow (which imports verify), so an oversized row is only refused later by cem cite. Expected: the row is bounded at emission or the bound moves to a shared package. Actual: deferred refusal.
title: --guarding-tests emits plan rows without checking the cem cite 1 MiB span bound
